hook: Septic pumping, dumpster rental, grease traps, biohazard cleanup. Here are 15 ugly businesses nobody wants, why the weak competition makes them profitable, and how to start one without betting everything.
shorts: The businesses nobody wants are often the ones quietly making people rich
This is the cleanup business that charges premium prices because nobody else will do it
Somebody has to clean the bins. That somebody can build a subscription business
The reason you don't want this business is the same reason it's profitable
Here's how to choose an ugly business and start it without betting everything
